_comment: Portraits and names are keyed by CLASS ID (hex, uppercase), not by the rNN roster byte.
The roster byte is an array position that compacts when a unit dies -- Sain was r02 in
Ch.3 and Kent is r02 from Ch.9 on -- so it is not a stable identity. In Lyn's tale every
character has a unique class except cls28 (Kent and Sain); Sain died in Ch.4, so cls28 is
Kent for the rest of this run. If that ever stops being true, add a bySlot override below.
PROMOTION CHANGES THE CLASS ID. Wallace used his Knight Crest in Ch.10 and went from
cls14 (Knight) to cls16 (General), so he needs both entries. Any promotion from here on
needs the new class adding, or the unit shows up as a bare cls ID.
Portrait files go in public/portraits/. A missing file falls back to a placeholder tile.
